observations: Photo 0: A single used car tire lies flat on white tiles; tread pattern visible but no sidewall markings legible; hand and partial second tire at edges.
Photo 1: Same tire from a slightly different angle; watermark "D-KACHI ENTERPRISE" across tread; no brand or model readable.
Photo 2: Two tires stacked; top tire sidewall shows partial raised lettering starting with "MASTER" but full brand is cut off; bottom tire shows tread only.
Seller reply: claims to have tested it yesterday and says everything is true; no new photo or document was sent.

claims.evidence: No paperwork, vehicle history, or grading document shown

claims.claim: will last almost like new brand ones
claims.evidence: Photos cannot predict remaining service life
No tread depth gauge, coin test, or wear-bar photo provided
Photos do not show the full circumference or inner liner
No vehicle, registration, or removal receipt shown

claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true
claims.evidence: Seller's word only; no new photo, test result, or independent verification

risks.risk: Actual tread depth is much lower than 90 percent or unevenly worn
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tread with a depth gauge or coin placed across the grooves
risks.if_unproven: as a worn-out or scrap tire

risks.risk: Hidden patches, plugs, or internal repairs
risks.proof: Video rotating the tire to display all sidewalls and tread, or close-up of any repair marks
risks.if_unproven: as a damaged or unsafe tire

risks.risk: Sidewall bulges, cracks, or bead damage not visible in still photos
Tire rubber is old despite low tread wear
risks.proof: Photo of the DOT date code on the sidewall
risks.if_unproven: as aged rubber with limited remaining life

risks.risk: Tire size does not fit the buyer's vehicle
risks.proof: Clear photo of the sidewall size marking such as section width, aspect ratio, and rim diameter
risks.if_unproven: as wrong fitment with no resale value to this buyer

proof_requests: Clear photo of sidewall size marking and DOT date code
Video rotating the tire to show all sidewalls and tread for patches, bulges, or cracks
Close-up of tread with depth gauge or coin to verify remaining tread
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used car tire from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's verbal assurance adds no new evidence.
